question: May the counted `SkillFrontmatter` plugin SDK export be removed here, or must the PR preserve it as a compatibility alias?
rationale: The patch deliberately reduces a public SDK surface budget, but the available history does not establish whether this type is an intentionally removable, unshipped export or a supported external contract.

options.title: Preserve a type alias
options.body: Keep the parser fix while retaining `SkillFrontmatter` as an alias to the canonical parsed skill-frontmatter type, avoiding an unnecessary consumer break.

options.title: Approve the removal
options.body: Remove the export only after confirming it was not present in a shipped plugin SDK contract or that a documented deprecation and upgrade path is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Preserve a type alias
recommendation.body: Keep the parser fix while retaining `SkillFrontmatter` as an alias to the canonical parsed skill-frontmatter type, avoiding an unnecessary consumer break.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history in the skill-frontmatter parser path and can help determine whether the old type was intentional.
